page.layout: One page of running text in one column. In the right margin, beside the second paragraph's first line, one short marginal note. Running head at top; page number at top right.

main_text.p: Hoc autem Iesuitæ non aliam ob causam fecerunt, quàm quòd viderent, se stante & defensa Reipub. Venetæ libertate stantibusq; legibus nec stare nec instituti sui finem obtinere posse. Quod ipsum sanè discrimen illud, quod inter Iesuitas & quoscunq; alios Clericos constituimus, satis euidenter probat & confirmat. Tu ergo nunc, mi Frater, cogita, quid de Polonia nostra futurum sit, si interna omnia illa remoueri debeant, vt profecto illa remota cupiunt, per quæ in finis istius adeptione impediuntur? Adhuc de Fine.

Videamus nunc Mediafiue[?] praxin, per quâ Praxis Iesuitica. ad scopum illum perrumpere conantur, & hæc ex iis, quæ iam dicta sunt, facilè intelliguntur. Hoc nimirum coniuncta opera feruidissimè agunt, vt primum Reges Europæos, quotquot possunt, vni cuidam Fœderi illigent: cuius Fœderis principem & directorem constituunt Hispaniarū regem, Aurei istius velleris possef-sorem & custodem. Ad cuius videlicet nutum reliqui se applicare cogantur, sub hac conditione, vt qui conatibus eius quacunque ratione intercedit aut quàm minimum aduersatur, de hæresi suspectus sit, & prædicti velleris per-nifcelide[?] indignus cēseatur. Sed regnorum Septentrionalium ea ferè est ratio, vt ad Legum præscriptum, non autem ad absolutum Regū arbitrium regantur. Ideoq; regiarum Personarum confœderatio parum illis prodesse poterit, nisi etiam subiectā[?] regibus regna in eandem

page.notes: Marginal note "Praxis Iesuitica." is partly cut; the last letters are read as "tica." Page number read as 203 with doubt about the second digit. The word "pe-rnifcelide" at the line break is not clear. "Mediafiue" may be two words "Media siue" with the space lost. "subiectā" is uncertain, the mark over the a may be a different sign. The paragraph ending with "eandem" continues on the next page. Running head is "REGNO POLON. EXPELL." Ink damage and show-through are present in the lower part of the page but no text is lost there.
